title: Fix two bugs in a Go Fibonacci implementation
description: A Go package provides Fib(n) and FibMemo(n). Fib has a base case bug (returns n==1 instead of n<=1), FibMemo initializes the memo incorrectly (map not initialized).

task_spec.prompt:
Fix two bugs in fib.go:
1. `Fib`: change `if n == 1` to `if n <= 1` so Fib(0) returns 0 correctly
2. `FibMemo`: change `var memo map[int]int` to `var memo = make(map[int]int)` so the map is initialized
All 2 test functions must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
